```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
```

# Import data {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}

```{r import-decision-tasks}
# Decision task files from both survey waves (Bilendi 2023, Dynata 2024)
decision_files <- c(
  list.files(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi"), pattern = "decision_block_", full.names = TRUE),
  list.files(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2024_12_Dynata"), pattern = "decision_block_", full.names = TRUE)
)

decision_tasks <- read_csv(decision_files, col_types = cols(participant_label = col_character()))
```

```{r import-completes}
# Participants who completed the survey
completes <- read_csv(
  c(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi", "Completes_sl12.csv"),
    here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi", "Completes_fl.csv"),
    here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2024_12_Dynata", "Completes_fl2.csv")),
  col_types = cols(participant_label = col_character())
)
```

```{r keep-completes}
# Lower-case session labels ("Indonesia" vs "indonesia") so the join matches
completes$session_label <- tolower(completes$session_label)
decision_tasks$session_label <- tolower(decision_tasks$session_label)

# Drop participants who did not complete the survey
decision_tasks <- inner_join(decision_tasks, completes, by = c("participant_label", "session_label"))
```

# Data prep {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}

```{r rename-columns}
decision_tasks <- decision_tasks %>%
  mutate(price_of_redist = to_goal_1_max / to_goal_2_max) %>%
  rename(to_goal1 = to_goal_1,
         to_goal2 = to_goal_2,
         to_goal1_max = to_goal_1_max,
         to_goal2_max = to_goal_2_max)
```

```{r goal-pairs}
# Goal codes are only recorded in the first round of a block: fill them down
decision_tasks <- decision_tasks %>%
  group_by(participant_code) %>%
  fill(goal1_code, goal2_code, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(goal_pair = paste0(goal1_code, "-", goal2_code), .after = goal2_code) %>%
  arrange(session_label, participant_label)
```

```{r block-numbers}
# Block number = alphabetical rank of the goal pair within a participant (not the order played)
decision_tasks <- decision_tasks %>%
  group_by(participant_label) %>%
  mutate(block_number = dense_rank(goal_pair)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r budget-shares}
# Prices and budget shares per goal (input for the Matlab estimation)
decision_tasks <- decision_tasks %>%
  mutate(price_goal1 = 1 / to_goal1_max,
         price_goal2 = 1 / to_goal2_max,
         price_ratio = price_goal1 / price_goal2,
         to_goal1_p = to_goal1 * price_goal1 / (to_goal1_max * price_goal1),  # expenditure / budget
         to_goal2_p = to_goal2 * price_goal2 / (to_goal2_max * price_goal2))
```

```{r participant-id}
# Numeric participant id
decision_tasks <- decision_tasks %>%
  group_by(participant_label) %>%
  mutate(id = cur_group_id(), .before = participant_label) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Export {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}

```{r export}
write_csv(decision_tasks, here("1_Data", "2_processed", "Data_decision_task_online.csv"))
```
